//: THE grounding index. Customer-editable declaration for an existing document/chunk Azure AI
Search index. With RETRIEVAL_BACKEND=grounding this file is loaded BY DEFAULT - no
ENGAGEMENTS_INDEX_SCHEMA path is needed - both from the repo and from engagements-mcp.zip,
which packages it as config/rag-index.json next to the running process.
Edit indexName and fields to match the deployed customer index. The field names below are what
Azure AI Search's 'Import and vectorize data' wizard produces; change them if yours differ.
Check it offline before any Azure call:
Never run provision:search ensure, sync, or reindex against a customer-owned index - `ensure`
would reshape it and `sync` would push demo records into it.
//indexName: REQUIRED. The name of the existing index, exactly as it appears in the search service.
Left as the <placeholder> the server refuses to load this file, rather than sending the
placeholder to Azure and surfacing an opaque 404.
//mapping: No `entityType` block: this corpus holds text, not structured contact/event records, so it
cannot drive the deterministic trip planner. RETRIEVAL_BACKEND=grounding therefore registers
only the search_grounding tool, and nothing is read from engagement-intelligence/seed.

//grounding: content  REQUIRED, must be `searchable` - the passage text an answer is grounded in.
parentId optional, must be `filterable` - collapses many chunks of one document to its best
passage, so a long PDF cannot occupy every result slot.
vector   optional, must be Collection(Edm.Single) - turns recall hybrid (BM25 + kNN + RRF).
The index needs a VECTORIZER on its vector profile, because queries pass raw text.
Set it to null when the index has no vectors, or vectors but no vectorizer; recall
then falls back to keyword search.
semanticConfiguration null here on purpose: naming one that does not exist on the index
fails EVERY query with an HTTP 400. Set it to the index's semantic configuration
(the wizard names it <index-name>-semantic-configuration) to add the L2 reranker.
